Axiom:
The file name decides where the code runs: - `+page.server.ts`, `+layout.server.ts`, `hooks.server.ts`, anything under `$lib/server/` — **server-only**. Allowed to read filesystem, talk to databases, use private env. - `+page.ts`, `+layout.ts`, `.svelte` (instance script + template) — **universal/client**. MUST be safe to ship to the browser.
Private secrets (`$env/static/private`, `$env/dynamic/private`) MUST NOT be imported from universal/client files. The toolchain refuses such imports at build time — agent's job is to keep the import graph clean from the start, not to rely on the compile error as the only guardrail.
